provider_responses.text: The key requirement is that the platform lets users quickly edit a work-experience entry without changing the overall layout. Users should be able to replace the employer, job title, dates, and responsibilities with a concise freelance role, such as AI automation and content creation, then copy the updated text directly into an application form.

provider_responses.text:
The product should provide a ready-to-copy entry such as:

```text
Freelance AI Automation & Content Creation (01/2024–Present)
• Created AI-assisted content for digital platforms.
• Built simple automations to streamline content and business tasks.
• Used AI tools for writing, research, editing, and workflow improvement.
```

This gives users a clear, professional replacement they can paste directly into a CV or application form.

provider_responses.text:
It may be unclear what “AI automation” actually involved. To avoid sounding vague or overstated, the entry should mention realistic tasks and tools only if they were genuinely used, such as workflow automation, AI-assisted writing, content editing, research, prompt creation, or social-media content planning.

It should also clarify that the work was freelance/self-employed rather than employment at a company, and use accurate dates.
